overview: Social Alpha is a full-stack lab-to-market platform that supports science- and technology-led innovations addressing critical social, economic, and environmental challenges. It enables mission-driven entrepreneurs to de-risk, deploy, and scale deep-tech innovations across sectors such as energy, health, agriculture, and climate through incubation, seed funding, mentorship, market access, and deployment partnerships. Since 2016, Social Alpha has supported 450+ startups, awarded 200+ catalytic grants, made 100+ seed investments, and unlocked 150 million+ in follow-on capital, with impact reaching 3.5 million+ people across 400+ districts in 28 states and union territories.
objectives: De-risk, deploy, and scale deep-tech innovations across energy, resources, materials, food systems, and health
Support mission-driven entrepreneurs from lab to market through a full-stack architecture
Unlock capital from philanthropy, venture capital, and strategic investors for social innovations
Enable market adoption and real-world deployment of science and technology solutions
Provide catalytic grants and seed investments to de-risk innovations at early stages
Facilitate market access and procurement pathways for startups
Build deployment partnerships for real-world scaling and follow-on investment
Nurture entrepreneurs through structured programs like Techtonic, Entrepreneur-in-Residence, and incubation labs
eligibility: An applying start-up should be a registered company in India, preferably be a DPIIT registered/applied start-up and should have completed a minimum of three months of association with Social Alpha in its resident or virtual incubation program. The start-up should have developed clarity on their Unique Selling Preposition (USP) through customer validation and a value proposition for its targeted customers. This support is not meant for Indian Subsidiaries of MNCs/foreign companies. Persons holding Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) and Persons of Indian Origin (PIO) would be considered as Indian citizens for the purpose of this scheme. The shareholding by Indian promoters in the start-up should be at least 51%. Preference will be given to start-ups who have not availed any funding from any Government of India /State Govt. body. The application should mandatorily include a declaration by the applying start-up that they have not received any NIDHI-seed support from any other DST supported Incubator.
benefits: Access to innovation labs for product development, design, iterations, and testing; real-world test beds and pilots; technical and regulatory support for compliance, regulatory support, guidance to help startups navigate compliance, certifications, and technical benchmarks; early risk capital through catalytic grants and seed investments; market access and procurement pathways to catalyze demand and connect with procurement channels; deployment partnerships for real-world deployment and follow-on investment; mentorship and knowledge services including bootcamps, masterclasses, and theme-based workshops; shared services for accounting, taxation, legal, IP, HR, and payroll; access to development sector partnerships with Tata Trusts and Government of India; opportunity to pitch for seed funding and access to follow-on capital from investor networks.
financial_support: Social Alpha provides catalytic grants and seed investments to de-risk innovations at the earliest stages. Under the NIDHI Seed Support Scheme hosted by Social Alpha, a seed fund with a corpus of INR 10 crores offers financial assistance for technology/product development, de-risking activities, testing and trials, marketing, mentoring, professional consultancy, IPR issues, and manpower for day-to-day operations. Financial support is disbursed based on milestones and monitored by the NIDHI-Seed Support Management Committee (NIDHI-SSMC). Startups can also access seed investment up to INR 50 lakh through the Entrepreneur-in-Residence (EIR) Fellowship and up to INR 1 crore through programs like the Namma Bengaluru Challenge. Grant support under Techtonic: Innovations for Sustainability includes up to INR 30 lakhs for R&D, INR 40 lakhs for Pilot, and INR 60 lakhs for Scale-Up tracks.
grant_amount_per_entity: Up to INR 60 lakhs (under Techtonic Scale-Up track)
application_process: 1. Visit the Social Alpha website and navigate to the relevant program page (e.g., Techtonic, NIDHI-SSS, EIR, or Namma Bengaluru Challenge). 2. Review eligibility criteria and program details. 3. Click on 'Apply Now' or 'View Details' to access the application form. 4. Fill in the application with details about your startup, including innovation focus, stage of development, team information, and financial needs. 5. Upload required documents such as Certificate of Incorporation, PAN, pitch deck, and declaration of no prior NIDHI-seed support from other DST incubators (if applicable). 6. Submit the application and await review by the respective selection committee (e.g., NIDHI-SSMC, SpIN Selection Committee, or Social Alpha portfolio team). 7. Shortlisted candidates may be invited for interviews, pitches, or due diligence. 8. Selected startups will receive formal communication and onboarding into the program.
required_documents: Declaration of not having received NIDHI-seed support from any other DST supported Incubator
Proof of association with Social Alpha incubation program (minimum 3 months)
Customer validation evidence for Unique Selling Proposition (USP)
Shareholding pattern showing Indian promoter holding ≥51%
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted year-round for most programs (e.g., EIR, NIDHI-SSS). Specific programs like Techtonic and Namma Bengaluru Challenge have defined cycles (e.g., quarterly reviews).
implementing_agency: Foundation for Innovation and Social Entrepreneurship (FISE)
contact_details: Email: connect@socialalpha.org | For NIDHI-SSS: connect@socialalpha.org | For SPIN: spin@socialalpha.org | For EIR: apply via website form | General: Get in touch via https://socialalpha.org/get-involved/
caveats: Preference is given to start-ups that have not received funding from any Government of India or State Govt. body
Indian Subsidiaries of MNCs/foreign companies are not eligible for NIDHI Seed Support Scheme
Shareholding by Indian promoters must be at least 51%
Applicants must declare they have not received NIDHI-seed support from any other DST-supported incubator
Financial support under NIDHI-SSS shall not be used for repayment of loans, creation of personal assets, inter-corporate deposits, speculative purposes, or personal benefit of promoters
Program-specific eligibility applies (e.g., SPIN requires space-tech focus, Techtonic requires sustainability/agri/health focus)
Some programs (e.g., Techtonic: Innovations for Sustainability) have closed applications as of the latest update
